A 17 September arXiv preprint reports that training-free SafeHarness—adding obstacle-aware route planning and contact execution to a GPT-6 coding-agent stack—raised TSR from 31.0% to 71.9% and CAR from 59.0% to 87.5% on all 32 SafeLIBERO tasks.

The authors attribute the improvement to the two harnesses—plan–verify–execute route planning plus obstacle-aware contact execution—but caution that the simulation-first, single-obstacle setting uses an axis-aligned box and that route verification checks only intersection with the grounded obstacle box; SafeHarness still displaced the obstacle in about one episode in eight.
